We are primarily looking for someone passionate about iOS app development to work on our apps, Trawel.in and InstaHelp. Strong hands-on knowledge of Swift, SwiftUI, Xcode and iOS development is preferred. Familiarity with Android and web development will be an added advantage. Experience with APIs, debugging, Git and AI-assisted coding tools such as Claude is desirable. Candidates with 0–2 years of experience who can commit to the full duration are encouraged to apply.

internships.title: AICTE Internship Portal
internships.company: All India Council for Technical Education
internships.description: The All India Council for Technical Education's official internship portal, listing internships for students across India. Students can search by city, sector, and duration.

internships.title: Code for GovTech (C4GT)
internships.description: An Indian open-source mentoring program that places contributors on public-good projects with government and nonprofit partners. Selected contributors work with maintainers on live GovTech products.

internships.title: GirlScript Summer of Code
internships.description: An open-source contribution program for beginners in India, with mentors, project listings, and rewards for top contributors. Participants make pull requests to real projects over the summer.

internships.title: Google Scholarships
internships.description: Google's scholarship programs for computer science students, including the Generation Google Scholarship and awards for students with disabilities. Eligibility and award amounts vary by region.

internships.title: Google Season of Docs
internships.description: Google's annual program that pairs technical writers with open-source organizations for mentored documentation projects. Writers receive a stipend set by the participating organization.

internships.title: Google Summer of Code
internships.description: Google's annual open-source program that pairs students with mentor organizations for a paid summer project. The organization list is published in February and applications typically open in March.

internships.title: LFX Mentorship
internships.description: The Linux Foundation's mentorship program with paid, remote projects across cloud, security, networking, and open-source infrastructure. New terms open several times a year.

internships.title: Microsoft Learn Student Ambassadors
internships.description: A global community program for student leaders who learn and teach Microsoft technologies on campus. Ambassadors get access to learning resources, events, and a global student community.

internships.title: MLH Fellowship
internships.description: A 12-week remote fellowship where students contribute to open-source projects in small pods with mentor support. Tracks include open source, production engineering, and site reliability.

internships.title: National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS)
internships.description: A Government of India apprenticeship program for fresh graduates and diploma holders, with one-year training positions in public and private organizations across the country.

internships.title: NVIDIA Graduate Fellowship
internships.description: NVIDIA's PhD fellowship supports graduate research in accelerated computing, AI, graphics, and related fields for one academic year. Fellows are paired with an NVIDIA researcher.

internships.title: Outreachy
internships.description: Paid, remote open-source internships for people subject to systemic bias and underrepresentation in tech. The program runs twice a year with a mentorship contribution period before the internship.

internships.title: PM Internship Scheme
internships.description: The Prime Minister's Internship Scheme offers 12-month internships in top Indian companies for youth aged 21–24, with a monthly stipend and a one-time grant. Applications are made through the official portal.

internships.title: Season of KDE
internships.description: KDE's annual mentorship program for students and newcomers to contribute to KDE open-source projects with a dedicated mentor. Projects span desktop apps, frameworks, and infrastructure.

internships.title: Summer of Bitcoin
internships.description: A global program that pairs students with Bitcoin open-source projects for a paid summer of remote mentorship and contribution. Applicants complete a short online course before project selection.
